name: claudespace
description: Claude Code plugins generated from the indexed Claudespace resource catalogs.

plugins.name: academic-paper
plugins.description: Academic paper writing skill with 12-agent pipeline. v2.5: Style Calibration (learn author's writing voice from past papers) + Writing Quality Check (writing quality checklist for natural prose). Supports IMRaD, literature review, theoretical, case study, policy brief, and conference paper structures. APA 7.0 (default), Chicago, MLA, IEEE, Vancouver citation formats. Bilingual abstracts (zh-TW + EN). Multi-format output (LaTeX, DOCX, PDF, Markdown). Triggers on: write paper, academic paper, paper outline, write abstract, revise paper, check citations, convert to LaTeX, guide my paper, parse reviews, revision roadmap, 寫論文, 學術論文, 論文大綱, 寫摘要, 修改論文, 檢查引用, 引導我寫論文, 帶我規劃論文, 逐章規劃, 論文架構, 審查意見, 修訂路線圖.

plugins.name: academic-paper-reviewer
plugins.description: Multi-perspective academic paper review with dynamic reviewer personas. Simulates 5 independent reviewers (EIC + 3 peer reviewers + Devil's Advocate) with field-specific expertise. Supports full review, re-review (verification), quick assessment, methodology focus, and Socratic guided modes. Triggers on: review paper, peer review, manuscript review, referee report, review my paper, critique paper, simulate review, editorial review.

plugins.name: academic-pipeline
plugins.description: Orchestrator for the full academic research pipeline: research -> write -> integrity check -> review -> revise -> re-review -> re-revise -> final integrity check -> finalize. Coordinates deep-research, academic-paper, and academic-paper-reviewer into a seamless 10-stage workflow with mandatory integrity verification, two-stage peer review, and reproducible quality gates. Triggers on: academic pipeline, research to paper, full paper workflow, paper pipeline, end-to-end paper, research-to-publication, complete paper workflow.

plugins.name: agent-browser
plugins.description: Browser automation skill bundle with fixed upstream source; requires a compatible CLI.

plugins.name: agent-led-swe
plugins.description: 围绕用户需求和变更目标，指导 Agent 主导的软件开发，从澄清需求、设计到经过验证的交付。结合人类决策、项目工程约定和可追溯记录，协调相关工作。适用于需要这类协调的软件开发或变更任务，也可显式调用；根据任务规模裁剪。

plugins.name: analyze-peer-work
plugins.description: Analyze papers, frameworks, open-source projects, and technical designs against the user's own needs; assess mechanisms, evidence, applicability, and what to borrow, then synthesize readable findings. Use for 参考工作分析、框架调研、按需求比较方案、借鉴设计与实现，或将已有调研整理成需求驱动的文档. Do not use for a standalone summary, term explanation, independent peer review, routine code review, or implementation alone.

plugins.name: aris
plugins.description: ARIS research skills, pinned upstream plugin; optional, not installed by catalog registration.

plugins.name: autoresearchclaw
plugins.description: Seven AutoResearchClaw research skills; Python runtime and provider credentials are separate.

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Universal deep research agent team. 13-agent pipeline for rigorous academic research on any topic. 7 modes: full research, quick brief, paper review, lit-review, fact-check, Socratic guided research dialogue, and systematic review with optional meta-analysis. Covers research question formulation, Socratic mentoring, methodology design, systematic literature search, source verification, cross-source synthesis, risk of bias assessment, meta-analysis, APA 7.0 report compilation, editorial review, devil's advocate challenges, ethics review, and post-research literature monitoring. Triggers on: research, deep research, literature review, systematic review, meta-analysis, PRISMA, evidence synthesis, fact-check, guide my research, help me think through, 研究, 深度研究, 文獻回顧, 文獻探討, 系統性回顧, 後設分析, 事實查核, 引導我的研究, 幫我釐清, 幫我想想, 我不確定要研究什麼, 研究方向, 研究主題.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Use when the user wants to manage a GitHub repository workflow through git and gh, including local branch and sync operations, pull requests, issues, and CI runs.

plugins.name: goal-authoring
plugins.description: Author, review, and right-size Codex /goal prompts for durable multi-turn work. Use when a user asks to create, improve, critique, normalize, or split a Goal; convert an objective, plan, migration, experiment, research task, or retry loop into a verifiable execution contract with starting anchors, bounded authority, evidence, checkpoints, stopping conditions, and handoff. Prefer normal execution for one-turn work and split only independently deliverable outcomes.

plugins.name: karpathy-llm-wiki
plugins.description: Use when building or maintaining a personal LLM-powered knowledge base. Triggers: ingesting sources into a wiki, querying wiki knowledge, linting wiki quality, 'add to wiki', 'what do I know about', or any mention of 'LLM wiki' or 'Karpathy wiki'.

plugins.name: literature-review
plugins.description: Use when conducting a topic-first literature review across multiple papers, comparing methods, evidence, and coverage for a research question.

plugins.name: programming-practice
plugins.description: Coach hands-on programming practice with the learner doing the reasoning, coding, command execution, and debugging needed for the selected learning goal. Use for guided implementation, rebuilding programming fundamentals, course labs, exam practice, or requests to learn by doing without AI completing the work. Continue an active practice session across conceptual questions. Do not impose practice on standalone factual questions, ordinary delivery tasks, or requests to create or review a teaching skill.

plugins.name: read-paper
plugins.description: Use when reading a single research paper in a structured way to extract claims, evidence, methods, limitations, and critique.

plugins.name: research-brainstorm
plugins.description: Technical design discussion workflow for algorithm design, system architecture, data structure choices, performance strategy, and research engineering tradeoffs before coding. Use only when the user explicitly wants to brainstorm, compare approaches, reason through a design, clarify constraints, debate technical tradeoffs, or produce a design specification before implementation. Do not use for direct coding requests, routine bug fixes, ordinary task planning, PRDs, product requirements, or non-technical ideation.

plugins.name: research-dev-orchestrator
plugins.description: Coordinate research proposal, experiment design, reproducible experiment implementation, and open-source contribution workflows with a role-neutral coordinator and CLI-based coding agents as workers. Use when an agent needs to turn research or experiment goals into requirements, design decisions, task packets, worker dispatch, evidence-based review, and iterative implementation, or resume this workflow from existing materials at any stage, using repo-local filesystem protocols and Git worktree isolation.

plugins.name: sanctuary-translate
plugins.description: Claude Code 与 Desktop Code 双向翻译插件：输入侧写审查、原生译文输出块、修复与重试控制，以及本地 SQLite 持久版本。MCP 后端经插件内 launch-translator.sh 定位本机 Node 22，不依赖桌面应用 PATH。

plugins.name: skill-evaluator
plugins.description: Evaluate an existing agent skill with task-based tests, trigger checks, execution evidence, and baseline or version comparisons. Use when asked to test a SKILL.md, validate an agent-authored skill, diagnose skill regressions, or measure whether a skill helps. Writing a new skill or explaining skills alone does not require this workflow.

plugins.name: teach
plugins.description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.
